parameters.pairing: Within Primus ordinary/split35 pairs: same declared parameters and seeds, only trace representation changes. Across libraries: derived protocols and independent RNG streams.

g1.order: BootstrapKeyswitch, CBS has no input KS

g2.order: KeyswitchBootstrap: Primus ring KS, refined scalar KS; no modulus switch

parameters.external_consumer: G2 uses the same plaintext polynomial formula as Primus; G1 frozen author validation uses mix64(i XOR (0x1000+r)) & 3, also t8/depth1
parameters.ntt_author_weights: centered-Q digits; floor(Q/B^l); LUT uses 2*floor(g/2), differs from Primus power-of-two weights
parameters.input: MSB t2 for every newly timed group, G1 q1024, G2 native64
parameters.trace: G1: author forward /N, Primus normalized reverse. G2: ordinary or unsigned low35/high29 split trace; BR/SS remain ordinary. Refined forward trace and Primus reverse trace still differ.
parameters.sampling: LightFHE original sigma3.2 cutoff +/-4, corrected +/-39; Primus sigma3.2 discrete CDT +/-38; G2 refined rounded continuous Gaussian vs Primus truncated discrete Ziggurat.
parameters.input_ks: G1 none. G2 refined scalar 2048->636; Primus inverse extraction->ring KS->compact extraction (q=Q). Same L,b is not same noise distribution.
parameters.return: rank1 N2048, four-level full transformed GGSW (L,b)=(4,4); cbs_cmux adds encrypted t8 depth1 consumer; no scalar LWE return KS
parameters.classification: All cross-library comparisons are derived, not matched protocols. Within Primus precision pairs match declared parameters, consumer and seeds; auto-selected FFT plans may differ.
parameters.external_seeds: Key seeds42/43/44, timer uses42; input/candidate randomness follows each author adapter sequence, not Primus input1042/candidate2042 streams
